Mr.Sakthivel vs The Commissioner on 5 December, 2024 
Author: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan Bench: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan  W.
 BEFORE THE MADURAI BENCH OF MADRAS HIGH COURT  DATED: 05.12.2024  CORAM  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE G.K.ILANTHIRAIYAN  W.P (MD).No.9593 of 2019  and  W.M.P(MD)Nos.10782 & 752 of 2019  Mr.Sakthivel ...Petitio  Vs.
 1.The Commissioner,
 Tamilnadu Food Safety and Drugs Administration,
 359, Anna Salai,
 Chennai-6. 
 2.The Designated Officer,
 Tamilnadu Food Safety and Drugs Administration,
 (Food Safety Wing),
 Namakkal Municipality 1 & 2,
 Namakkal,
 Namakkal District.
 3.The Food Safety Officer,
 Tamilnadu Food Safety and Drugs Administration  (Food Safety Wing),
 Namakkal Municipality 1 & 2,
 Namakkal,
 Namakkal District. ...Respondents  Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  issue a Writ of Certiorari, to call for the records pursuant to the impu  notice of the second respondent vide proceedings  https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/4  W.P Mr.Sakthivel vs The Commissioner on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2475733/
1  2879/FSSA/2018/A2/2 dated 25.03.2019 and quash the same as illegal and  against the Section and procedure under the Food Safety and Standards Ac  2006, Rules 2011.
 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Sarvagan Prabhu  For R1 to R3 : Mr.D.Gandhi Raj  Special Government Ple  ORDER The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect. 
2. In view of the above, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. 
No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
